description: Use this only after `GET /api/intake/{uid}/issues` returns structured offers with `selection_token`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <intake_access_token>` from the latest consumer-prefill follow-up response. For umbrella, Coverage Cat collects consumer-report authorization here, after the user chooses an offer. A selected Monoline offer also requires a separate versioned MVR authorization: show the complete returned carrier-specific text and source URL, collect the shopper's separate answer, and send `credit_consent` plus `monoline_mvr_consent` in the same retry. If an umbrella offer exposes `um_uim_selection`, send the shopper's include-or-decline choice here as `um_uim_election` on the first select call. If the umbrella quote payload exposed `selection_guidance.same_reply_requirements` for the chosen offer, send those answers under `intake` on this first select call so the shopper can finish selection in one reply. If Coverage Cat returns a consent-required state with a bind-stage `next_question`, ask for all returned authorizations and bind details in one shopper-facing turn, then retry this same endpoint with the receipts and bind-stage answers under `intake`. Successful responses return detailed post-choose states rather than collapsing back into a coarse quoted bucket. For Monoline and Markel umbrella offers, once declarations uploads are on file, `documents_pending_review` usually transitions to `payment_needed` with a secure `payment_url` within about 5-10 minutes while declarations verification continues in parallel.

A callback that never arrives within the configured processing timeout is marked `FAILED` with `PROCESSING_TIMEOUT` by `finvera-be` itself, not by this endpoint.
**`finvera-be` validates `X-Internal-Api-Key` on this endpoint exactly as `finvera-ai` validates it on every endpoint it hosts** (research R-003, F1) — this is `finvera-be`'s own hosted internal endpoint, not a trusted-by-network-position exception. A request without a valid key is `401`, identically to every other path in this contract.
